Text: Almighty and everlasting God, You give to those who seek You in prayer out of Your inexhaustible love. [t] Giving to all of us beyond our merits and desires. Pour Your mercy upon us. [*] Free our minds from what worries them. Give us more what we dare ask, through Jesus Christ.
